name: What happens to the old roofing materials after they are removed?

mainEntity.name: What happens to the old roofing materials after they are removed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Old roofing materials are typically collected and disposed of in specialized debris containers or dumpsters provided by the roofing company. These materials are then hauled away to a proper waste disposal facility or, in some cases, recycled where facilities are available. We ensure responsible disposal as part of our service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Old roofing materials are collected in dumpsters and hauled to a waste disposal facility or recycled, if possible.
